name: Maadi solar thermal irrigation pumping
description: Sunlight supplied heat for a steam engine that pumped irrigation water near Cairo.

impact.note: One solar-steam pumping plant, after earlier solar engines; abandoned within years, with later trough plants not directly resting on it.

places.note: Modern country or regional reference; historic political boundaries are not implied.

date.basis: The cited source dates this event.

events.statement: Shuman and Boys installed a solar-powered steam pumping engine for irrigation near Cairo.
events.caveats: The reported 50 hp is not included because other accounts report different ratings.

evidence.supports: The World Bank report states the date, purpose and named engineers.

earliest_record.rationale: Earliest event sourced for this particular record; not a claim of global origin.

caveats: The report also identifies earlier French solar steam machinery; this is not assumed to be a global first.

research.note: Initial sourced admission; classification and interpretations await independent review.
